items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Russ said, 'Why don't you have this guy make some arrangements for you?' ... he said to Charlie, and he said, 'Okay, what do you want to do.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Said that Whiteman offered him a job. Well, I'm positive that Whiteman didn't. I wouldn't go out on a limb and say that, but actually I can't say it because I wasn't there, but they didn't get him in there. Bix was the kind of a guy that could, as I say, if Charlie were there and he had good guys surrounding him that could read, he could read. No problem.

But to take a part and mark it, segue down to here, cut here and move down to here, that's studio expertise and Charlie had that and a lot of the other guys in the band had that, but not Bix. Bix wants to know on his part, where do I
